2. Using the Card; Limitations

We will deduct the amount of your Cardholder Transactions directly from any funds available in your Stored Value Account associated with your Card. You understand that third-party locations where you use your Card may assess additional fees and charges. You should check to be sure you have a sufficient balance on your Stored Value Account to pay for each Cardholder Transaction and all applicable fees as set forth in the Fee Schedule (see section 6 below) by logging into your Stored Value Account. If you attempt a Cardholder Transaction for more than the value available on your Stored Value Account, then the Cardholder Transaction will be declined. In the event that, for any reason including a system malfunction, you are able to complete a Cardholder Transaction in excess of the value available on your Stored Value Account, you agree to pay us the full amount of any negative balance immediately without further demand (see section 5 below).
You may use your Card as described below.

You may obtain cash at any automated teller machine (ATM) that accepts VISA® cards, subject to any applicable daily limits on your Stored Value Account. Note that ATM owners may set limits on the amount of cash you can withdraw from their ATMs and may charge fees for use of their ATMs. The Card can be used at international ATMs.
You may use your Card to make purchases anywhere VISA® is accepted.
Some of these services may not be available at all locations.

3. Account Information; Receipts

You may obtain information regarding your Card and available funds associated with your Stored Value Account by viewing the Money Section or calling 888-606-9669. The history of your Cardholder Transactions is also available via the Money Section. You will not automatically receive paper statements.

You can get a receipt at the ATM when you conduct a Cardholder Transaction and at the point-of-sale when you use your Card at a merchant location. The receipt will usually indicate the date, time, place and amount of the Cardholder Transaction, but may not indicate the remaining balance on your Stored Value Account.
4. Authorization Holds

When you use your Card to pay for goods or services at certain merchants or to reserve some types of goods or services, we may, or the merchant may ask us to, preauthorize the Cardholder Transaction and may estimate its final value. If we preauthorize the Cardholder Transaction, we will place a temporary use restriction or “hold” on your Stored Value Account’s funds for the estimated amount of the Cardholder Transaction. During the hold period, the preauthorized amount in the Stored Value Account will not be accessible. We will not be responsible if any transactions are not completed because of the hold. IMPORTANT—in many instances the amount of the estimated Cardholder Transaction may exceed the amount of the actual final Cardholder Transaction. By way of example, a purchase at a restaurant may result in an estimated Cardholder Transaction of the purchase price and an estimated gratuity (tip) of twenty percent (20%). When settlement for the final amount of the Cardholder Transaction occurs, any hold will be released, and your Stored Value Account balance will be reduced in an amount corresponding to the final Cardholder Transaction amount. In addition, some merchants may add an amount to the Cardholder Transaction in order to ensure sufficient funds will be available to cover the final Cardholder Transaction. If the amount of the authorization request exceeds the value on your Stored Value Account, then the Cardholder Transaction is likely to be declined.

THE DURATION OF A HOLD WILL NORMALLY BE SEVEN (7) DAYS OR LESS, BUT CERTAIN CATEGORIES OF MERCHANTS, SUCH AS RENTAL CAR COMPANIES AND HOTELS, MAY CAUSE A HOLD ON YOUR AVAILABLE BALANCE FOR UP TO THIRTY (30) DAYS. UNTIL THE FINAL AMOUNT OF THE CARDHOLDER TRANSACTION IS DETERMINED OR UNTIL WE DETERMINE THAT THE CARDHOLDER TRANSACTION IS UNLIKELY TO BE PROCESSED, THE FUNDS SUBJECT TO THE HOLD WILL NOT BE AVAILABLE FOR OTHER USE. ONCE THE FINAL CARDHOLDER TRANSACTION AMOUNT IS DETERMINED, WE WILL CHARGE YOUR CARD ONLY FOR THE AMOUNT OF THE FINAL CARDHOLDER TRANSACTION AND WE WILL RELEASE ANY EXCESS AMOUNT FROM THE HOLD AT THAT TIME. IN ADDITION, IF YOU BEGIN A PURCHASE AND THE MERCHANT OBTAINS AN AUTHORIZATION, AND THEN YOU CANCEL THE PURCHASE WITHOUT COMPLETING IT, THE AUTHORIZATION MAY RESULT IN A TEMPORARY “HOLD” FOR THE AMOUNT OF THE PURCHASE FOR AT LEAST SEVEN (7) DAYS. BY USING YOUR CARD, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE AND AGREE THAT WE MAY PLACE A HOLD ON YOUR CARD AS INDICATED ABOVE.
5. Negative Balances

You must be sure you have sufficient value in your Stored Value Account associated with your Card to pay for each Cardholder Transaction and all applicable fees as set forth in the Fee Schedule. If you attempt a Cardholder Transaction for more than the value available in your Stored Value Account, then the Cardholder Transaction may be declined. In the event that, for any reason including a systems malfunction, you are able to complete a Cardholder Transaction in excess of the value available on your Stored Value Account (creating a “negative balance”), you agree to pay us the full amount of any negative balance immediately without further demand. We do not offer overdraft protection services on your Stored Value Account. You agree we may, without providing prior notice to you, deduct any amount you owe to us from the funds on your Stored Value Account and any future loads to your Stored Value Account to the extent permitted by applicable law, even if the deduction causes a negative balance on your Stored Value Account. Any negative balance is incidental and does not constitute an extension of credit.
6. Fees

You agree to pay the fees set forth in the Fee Schedule. You agree we may deduct the amount of such fees directly from any funds associated with your Stored Value Account. To obtain the current Fee Schedule, please see the Money Section of X Platform or Appendix 1 and 2 of the Agreement.

ATM owners and other places where you use your Card may charge a surcharge or other fee (even for a balance inquiry without completing a fund transfer) and you agree we may deduct the amount of such fees directly from any funds associated with your Stored Value Account.

If you use your Card for a transaction outside the United States or in a currency other than US Dollars, then you may be charged a Foreign Transaction Fee as shown in your Fee Schedule. Foreign transactions include, for example, online purchases from foreign merchants and cash advances obtained from an ATM or financial institution in another country.

If you make a transaction in a foreign currency, the transaction will be converted by the VISA card network into U.S. dollars in accordance with the operating regulation or conversion procedures in effect at the time the transaction is processed. Currently, those regulations and procedures provide that the currency conversion rate to be used is either (1) a wholesale market rate or (2) a government-mandated rate on the date the transaction is processed, which may differ from the rate on the date the transaction occurred or the date the transaction is posted to your Stored Value Account.
7. Stop Payment of Preauthorized Payments or Transfers
If you have arranged in advance for recurring payments or transfers from your Card, you can stop those payments or transfers by following these procedures:

Call X Payments at 888-606-9669 or write to X Payments at: X Payments LLC, Attn: Customer Support, 1450 Page Mill Road, Palo Alto, California 94304, in time for us to receive your request at least 3 business days before the payment is scheduled to be made. If you call, we may also require you to put your request in writing and get it to us within 14 days after you call. If you fail to do so, your oral request to stop payment may not be honored.
In order to honor your request, we may need to cancel your current Card and issue a new Card to you.
You would be best advised to also notify the party that you authorized to initiate payments or transfers using your Card that you are cancelling your authorization.
If you order us to stop one of these payments three (3) Business Days or more before the scheduled payment date and we do not do so, we may be liable to you for your losses or damages.
Please note that your right to stop payments originating with your Card is limited to preauthorized, recurring payments only.

You may contact X Payments’ Money Customer Service to request to re-activate your Card if your Stored Value Account remains in good standing. For your security, you will need to provide personal information in order for your identity to be verified and for completion of the re-activation process.

The funds available through your Stored Value Account will not expire, regardless of the expiration date on the back of the Card associated with it. Remember to keep your address information current by updating your profile via the Money Section on the X Platform mobile app or website or by calling X Payments at 888-606-9669 or writing to X Payments at: X Payments LLC, Attn: Customer Support, 1450 Page Mill Road, Palo Alto, California 94304.

12. Losses, Errors, and Questions

Customer Service and error resolution support is provided by X Payments as service provider to Cross River. You should direct questions about Cardholder Transactions made with your Card to X Payments using the contact information provided below.

If you believe the Card or PIN has been used to make an unauthorized transaction, such as when the Card is lost, stolen or otherwise compromised, or that someone has used your Card without your permission, immediately notify us by using X Payments’ online form found at

using your X Account, or contacting X Payments’ Money Customer Support at 888-606-9669 or writing to X Payments at: X Payments LLC, Attn: Customer Support, 1450 Page Mill Road, Palo Alto, California 94304. You could lose all the money in your Stored Value Account. In addition to the limitations on your liability described below, you may be entitled to the benefits of any VISA “Zero Liability” policy in effect at the time of any unauthorized use of your Card. Under VISA Rules, you will not be held responsible for unauthorized transactions if you have used reasonable care in protecting the Card or PIN from loss or theft and you have promptly reported to us (through X Payments) when you knew that the Card or PIN was lost, stolen or used without your permission. A transaction is unauthorized if it is not initiated by you, you did not give permission to make the transaction and you do not benefit from the transaction in any way. VISA’s Zero Liability policy may not apply to certain commercial card transactions.

b: You must notify us promptly of any unauthorized use.

runs: In the event that someone uses your Card or PIN without your permission and VISA Zero Liability does not apply, if you tell us within two (2) Business Days of when you learn of the unauthorized transaction, you can lose no more than $50. If you do NOT tell us within two (2) Business Days after you learn of the unauthorized transaction, and we can prove we could have stopped someone from using your Card or PIN without your permission if you had told us, you could lose as much as $500. We may suspend or cancel the Card and/or corresponding Stored Value Account in the event of excessive reports of Card loss or theft.
The following are NOT considered unauthorized transactions:

If you give someone access to your Card (e.g., by giving a family member or coworker your Card and/or information) and they use your Card without your knowledge or permission, unless you have notified us (through X Payments) that transfers by that person are no longer authorized.
If you, or someone else you are working with, are acting with fraudulent intent.

Also, if you become aware of and/or your account history shows transfers that you did not make, TELL US AT ONCE (by contacting X Payments) following the procedures stated below. If you do not tell us within 60 days after the earlier of the date: (i) you electronically access your Stored Value Account, if the error could be viewed in your electronic history; or (ii) we sent the FIRST written history on which the error appeared, then you may not get back any money for transactions made after the 60 days if we can prove that we could have stopped someone from taking the money if you had told us in time. If a good reason (such as a long trip or a hospital stay) kept you from telling us, we will extend the time periods. Even if we are entitled under this Agreement and under applicable law to hold you responsible for a loss, we reserve the right to waive your liability in our sole discretion.

Why you believe there is an error, and the dollar amount involved.
Approximately when the error took place.
If you tell X Payments orally, we or X Payments may require that you send us or X Payments your complaint or question in writing within 10 Business Days.

We will generally determine whether an error occurred within 10 Business Days after we hear from you. If we need more time, however, we may take up to 45 days to investigate your complaint or question, or up to 90 days under certain circumstances. If we decide to do this, we will provisionally credit your Stored Value Account within 10 Business Days for the amount you think is in error, so that you will have the money during the time it takes us to complete our investigation. If we ask you to put your notice of error in writing and we do not receive it within 10 Business Days, we may not credit your Stored Value Account.

For errors involving new Stored Value Accounts, point-of-sale debit card transactions, or foreign-initiated Cardholder Transactions, we may take up to 90 days to investigate your complaint or question. For new Stored Value Accounts, we may take up to 20 Business Days to credit your account for the amount you think is in error.

We will tell you the results within three (3) Business Days after completing our investigation, including whether any provisional credit has been made final. If we determine that an error has occurred, we will correct the error within (1) Business Day of making that determination. If we decide that there was no error, we will send you a written explanation.

13. Liability

If, through no fault of ours, you do not have enough funds on your Stored Value Account to complete the Cardholder Transaction.
If the information supplied by you which is needed to complete a transaction is incorrect.
We have reason to believe that you did not authorize the transaction.
If the ATM, bank or merchant where you are trying to obtain cash does not have enough cash.

If the system, ATM, POS terminal, network, or other system utilized for the Cardholder Transaction was not working properly and either you knew about the problem when you initiated the Cardholder Transaction or the problem is due to reasons that are beyond our reasonable control.
If a merchant refuses to honor or accept your Card.
If circumstances beyond our control (such as fire, flood, terrorist attack or national emergency) prevent or delay the Cardholder Transaction, despite reasonable precautions that Issuer have taken.
If the Card has been reported lost or stolen, has been suspended by us, or the Issuer has reason to believe that the requested Cardholder Transaction was not authorized by you.
If the transaction is restricted by us, our processor, or another financial institution because of potentially unlawful or suspicious activity.
If your funds are subject to a legal process, lien, administrative process, or other encumbrance restricting transfer.
If your Card has been deactivated.

There also may be other exceptions stated in this Agreement or provided by applicable law. The list of examples set out in this section is meant to illustrate circumstances under which we would not be liable for failing to make a transfer and is not intended to list all of the circumstances in which we would not be liable.
